tasks.title: Build memori-gateway core logic
tasks.description: Install shared @memori-gateway/app/core.py dataclasses and chat_with_memory path so HTTP and MCP both use the same Memori + OpenAI workflow, including namespace handling and optional debug metadata.

comments.author: CODER
comments.body: Implemented the shared core/config and sanity-checked with python -m compileall memori-gateway/app.

tasks.title: Add FastAPI and MCP wrappers
tasks.description: Implement @memori-gateway/app/http_api.py (API key auth, /chat, /health) and @memori-gateway/app/mcp_server.py to expose the chat_with_memory tool while delegating to the shared core.

comments.author: CODER
comments.body: FastAPI + MCP layers added with CLI entrypoint and verified via python -m compileall memori-gateway/app.

tasks.title: Add Docker + compose deployment
tasks.description: Create the Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, requirements, and README notes so the MVP can run via docker-compose up with MEMORI + OpenAI env vars.

comments.author: CODER
comments.body: Added requirements, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, and README explaining gateway + Memori stack with external Supabase, validating the spec via docs/llms.txt.

tasks.title: Allow configurable gateway port
tasks.description: Make the memori-gateway HTTP service port configurable via environment variables in docker-compose and document it.

comments.author: CODER
comments.body: Gateway port now driven by GATEWAY_HTTP_PORT env plus README notes; also fixed BaseSettings import via pydantic-settings per new runtime error.
